2610.13447.title: Oído: Open-Vocabulary Speech Recognition on a $5 Microcontroller without a Neural Accelerator
2610.13447.paper_summary: Speech recognition on low-cost microcontrollers is, in practice, limited to keyword spotting or a fixed list of commands. We present Oído, an inference engine that runs open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on an ESP32-S3 (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 512 KB of SRAM, 8 MB of PSRAM, 16 MB of flash, no neural accelerator). Oído executes a 13M-parameter Conformer-CTC model with int8 weights, per-frame dynamic int8 activations and int8 attention on the chip's SIMD instructions, with a schedule designed around flash and PSRAM bandwidth. On LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other the on-device arithmetic reaches 3.70%/8.23% word error rate (WER), within 0.12 points of full precision, and 3.33%/7.15% with an on-chip 1.3M-parameter language model; a transducer head gives 2.99%/6.67% and an int4 variant fits in 8.3 MB. This is 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer on the same chip, and fewer than Whisper tiny.en and Moonshine tiny in full precision on a laptop, including in real noise and reverberation. Measured on a physical board, the firmware runs at 1.97x the duration of the audio on one core, with transcripts identical to an instruction-exact emulator: accurate, but not yet real time (a 4 s command is transcribed about 8.7 s after it ends). The two-core schedule gives wrong results on silicon and is disabled. A streaming variant shows partial text while the speaker talks and delivers the final text 4.1-11.1 s after clips of 3.6-10.6 s (7.2-22.4 s in utterance mode) at 4.86%/11.03% WER; a Spanish model makes 34-60% fewer errors than multilingual Whisper tiny. Code and models are released.
2610.13447.paper_summary_zh: 語音識別在低成本微控制器上的應用，實際上僅限於關鍵字檢測或固定命令列表。我們提出了 Oído，一個在 ESP32-S3（240 MHz 雙核 Xtensa LX7，512 KB SRAM，8 MB PSRAM，16 MB flash，無神經加速器）上完全運行開放詞彙英語語音識別的推理引擎。Oído 執行一個擁有 1300 萬參數的 Conformer-CTC 模型，使用 int8 權重、每幀動態 int8 激活和 int8 注意力，利用芯片的 SIMD 指令，並根據 flash 和 PSRAM 帶寬設計排程。在 LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other 上，設備內的運算達到 3.70%/8.23% 的字錯誤率 (WER)，與全精度相差 0.12 點，並且使用內建 130 萬參數的語言模型時達到 3.33%/7.15%；一個轉導頭的表現為 2.99%/6.67%，而 int4 變體則適合在 8.3 MB 中運行。這比供應商在同一芯片上的識別器少了 2.3-2.8 倍的錯誤，並且在全精度下比 Whisper tiny.en 和 Moonshine tiny 更少，包括在真實噪音和混響中。測量在實體板上，固件在一個核心上運行的時間為音頻的 1.97 倍，轉錄與指令精確的模擬器相同：準確，但尚未實時（4 秒的命令在結束後約 8.7 秒被轉錄）。雙核排程在硅上給出了錯誤的結果，因此被禁用。一個串流變體在講者講話時顯示部分文本，並在 3.6-10.6 秒的片段後 4.1-11.1 秒交付最終文本，WER 為 4.86%/11.03%；一個西班牙語模型的錯誤率比多語言 Whisper tiny 少 34-60%。代碼和模型已發布。
